title: Validity of a Bit Source
statement: For natural numbers $n,w,i$, a bit source is valid if it is an input bit with index less than $n$, a Boolean constant, or a bit with index $j<w$ from a block computed by an instruction with index less than $i$.
hypotheses_covered: natural numbers n, w, and i
